description: Long-standing gate guardian at the RNAS Culdrose main gate on the B3291/A3083 outside Helston, marked 'CU'; ex-instructional airframes A2645/A2623. Visible from the public road. Confirmed in place Mar 2026.
Retired from 736 NAS at Culdrose and preserved outside as a gate guardian, marked '280' in 736 NAS colours. Confirmed in place Mar 2026.
